name: Interior western North America
region: Rockies (Teton, Front Range, Canadian Rockies) and approximately the Sierra Nevada.
reference_site: Generic high alpine 3500 m (Teton/Front Range SNOTEL and ridge stations)
sources: Niwot Ridge LTER D1 station (3743 m)
Hersbach, H. et al. (2020) The ERA5 global reanalysis. QJRMS 146:1999-2049 (monthly climatology 1991-2020, 300 hPa winds)
notes: Summer afternoon thunderstorms (North American monsoon) are the main hazard; Sierra Nevada is drier and warmer in summer.
